decision_basis: Two independent Docker canonical-build cycles produced the same zte_tpd.ko SHA-256.
Candidate and stock AArch64 assembly have identical 50 instructions, 200-byte symbol size and resolved relocations.
Candidate and stock KCFI type IDs are identical: 0x7bff871d.
Strict Joern gate passed with zero parse problems and one-to-one source/Ghidra identity coverage.
The next13 firmware lifecycle harness passed 12/12 tests in both cycles, directly covering the copy success, boundary and failure paths.
